ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity black pixels (concentrated in the center and leading edges) to 25% high-intensity white pixels (concentrated on the distal tips).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region occupying the central 75% of the fluke span. Distal tips show high-intensity white pigmentation with irregular black mottling. Discrete white high-intensity pixel clusters (speckles) are mapped over the black central region, particularly in the medial and lower-medial areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 62 degrees and a depth ratio of 1:8 relative to the vertical span of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable jaggedness and irregular peaks are concentrated on the distal halves of both lobes. The right lobe tip shows a significantly more irregular and broken boundary than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edge displays a consistent convex curve. Trailing edge follows a complex convex sweep that is interrupted by deep serrations and a localized concavity near the right lobe tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters detected on the black background. One prominent ring-shaped white anomaly (approx. 10-15 pixels in diameter) is located left of the central notch. Numerous smaller point-source white spots are visible in the central-lower region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the white distal portion of the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular jaggedness on the distal apex of the right lobe, indicating significant past tissue loss. A prominent circular scar is visible in the black pigmentation near the center-left of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density distribution of white speckling across the dark central pigmentation, forming a distinct 'starfield' pattern.
